description:
Well we are designing a solution to understand the NASA's SphereX data and see how repeated observations can reveal changes in the Sky. Here in this project we can look out for Cosmic motion detection, Unusual objects Discovery, INfrared Universe timeline.
Here I'm looking for people who are all-in into astrophysics and just in love with outer Space, no barrier to entry all are welcome with any level of skill or achievements, lets build this together!!!
